env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ./.venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import copy, hashlib, io, json, stat, tarfile
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.research import companion_installer as install
from scripts.research import companion_runtime_adapter as adapter
from scripts.research import companion_network_configuration as network
from scripts.research import companion_install_env as env
root = Path.cwd()
base = root / "docs/review_artifacts/companion_continuation_20261020"
paths = {
    "candidate": base / "fresh_v5_capture_20261020/candidate_manifest.json",
    "capture": base / "fresh_v5_capture_20261020/capture.json",
    "original": root / "docs/review_artifacts/companion_install_candidate_20261018/configured_v3/reviewed_configured_plan.json",
    "engine_review": base / "engine_compatibility_review.json",
    "reviewed": base / "reviewed_preparation_manifest.json",
}
expected = {
    "candidate": "0ed18df8e95da122d2f00e31badeb17122fee2049609369c1dd819a832c6c108",
    "capture": "0fa450f65997a8ace714babc6b514270eab308cd22f623a6e06177ab3c09fa1b",
    "original": "f5b044858c3d40881239b77745d0b404c4ac05d2f35a6d043fed8f6ba934bf5f",
    "engine_review": "fc5ddf90d756f059c973639fd6bc05742235568835b3b2f3e246332f8d9a9f60",
    "reviewed": "3b6f785ca1dd732e307aa83b30dcea2a5d2d9379d57af06a4afaa3774df94635",
}
raw = {k: p.read_bytes() for k, p in paths.items()}
assert all(hashlib.sha256(raw[k]).hexdigest() == v for k, v in expected.items())
m, c, old, er, reviewed = (json.loads(raw[k]) for k in ("candidate", "capture", "original", "engine_review", "reviewed"))
assert er["decision"] == "ACCEPTED_WITH_RISK"
for path, sha in er["reviewed_sha256"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == sha
reviewer = "Codex independent GATE, preparation-packet review 2026-10-20 (separate from implementation)"
expected_bytes = raw["candidate"].replace(b'"decision":"INCOMPLETE"', b'"decision":"ACCEPTED_WITH_RISK"').replace(b'"reviewer":""', b'"reviewer":' + json.dumps(reviewer).encode()) + b"\n"
assert raw["reviewed"] == expected_bytes
assert {k for k in m if m[k] != reviewed[k]} == {"decision", "reviewer"}
assert reviewed["decision"] == "ACCEPTED_WITH_RISK" and reviewed["reviewer"] == reviewer
assert m["decision"] == "INCOMPLETE" and m["reviewer"] == ""
bindings = m["network_contract"]["bindings"]
assert m == {**old, "schema": "companion-staged-update-v5", "decision": "INCOMPLETE", "reviewer": "", "attempt": m["attempt"], "cli_sha256": c["cli_sha256"], "baseline": c["snapshots"], "network_contract": {"schema": network.CONTRACT, "bindings": c["network_bindings"], "connectivity_verified": False}}
assert c["observed_utc"] == "2026-10-20T22:50:27.663567+00:00"
assert c["engine"] == {"version": "29.9.1", "commit": "b26fb77"}
assert c["final_observations_match"] is True and c["attempt_labels_absent"] is True
assert m["policies"] == {"builder_local_only": True, "env_stdin_lossless": True, "image_provenance": True, "recreation_complete": True, "sdk_startup_compatible": False, "source_imports_frozen": False}
snapshots = []
for row in c["observations"]:
    configured, ids, evidence = network.project(row, bindings)
    assert row["state"] == "running" and row["restart_policy"] == "no"
    assert all(e[2] == "reported_id" for e in evidence)
    snapshots.append(asdict(install.Snapshot(row["name"].removeprefix("/"), row["id"], row["image"], row["state"], row["started"], row["restarts"], row["restart_policy"], adapter.preservation_digest(row), adapter.preservation_digest({**row, "networks": {}}), tuple(sorted(n["NetworkID"] for n in row["networks"].values())), configured_metadata=configured, configured_networks=ids, network_evidence=evidence)))
assert len(snapshots) == 7 and install.canonical(snapshots) == install.canonical(m["baseline"])
assert {r["name"]: r["id"] for r in old["baseline"]} == {r["name"]: r["id"] for r in m["baseline"]}
observations = {r["name"].removeprefix("/"): r for r in c["observations"]}
counts, files = [], set()
for app in m["applications"]:
    row = observations[app["name"]]
    destinations, total = set(), 0
    for s in app["sources"]:
        path = root / s["local"]
        assert path.resolve(strict=True) == path and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode)
        content = path.read_bytes()
        assert len(content) <= 1048576 and hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == s["sha256"]
        assert s["destination"] == "/app/" + s["local"].split("/", 1)[1]
        destinations.add(s["destination"]); files.add(s["local"]); total += len(content)
    assert total <= 8388608 and len(destinations) == len(app["sources"])
    assert adapter.required_app_sources(app["name"]).issubset(destinations)
    opts = dict(zip(app["create_options"][::2], app["create_options"][1::2]))
    assert len(opts) == len(app["create_options"]) // 2
    port = adapter.PORTS[app["name"]]
    assert opts["--publish"] == f"127.0.0.1:{port}:{port}/tcp"
    assert opts["--workdir"] == row["workdir"] == "/app"
    assert opts["--log-driver"] == row["log_driver"] == "local"
    assert opts["--health-cmd"] == row["healthcheck"]["Test"][1]
    assert opts["--health-interval"] == str(row["healthcheck"]["Interval"]) + "ns"
    assert opts["--health-timeout"] == str(row["healthcheck"]["Timeout"]) + "ns"
    assert opts["--health-retries"] == str(row["healthcheck"]["Retries"])
    assert app["command"] == row["command"]
    assert len(row["networks"]) == 1
    net = next(iter(row["networks"].values()))
    assert net["IPAMConfig"] in (None, {})
    assert app["network_options"] == [v for alias in net["Aliases"] for v in ("--alias", alias)]
    if app["name"] == "phase1-orchestrator":
        assert opts["--mount"] == f"type=bind,source={root},target=/repo,readonly,bind-propagation=rprivate"
        assert len(row["mounts"]) == 1
        mount = row["mounts"][0]
        assert (mount["Type"], mount["Source"], mount["Destination"], mount["RW"], mount["Propagation"]) == ("bind", str(root), "/repo", False, "rprivate")
    else:
        assert "--mount" not in opts and row["mounts"] == []
    projected = copy.deepcopy(row)
    flags = [dict(f) for f in row["flags"] if f is not None]
    present = set()
    for f in flags:
        if f["key"] in env._OVERRIDES: f["ok"] = True
        present.add(f["key"])
    flags.extend({"key": k, "ok": True} for k in env._OVERRIDES if k not in present)
    projected["flags"] = [*flags, None]
    assert network.project(projected, bindings)[0] == app["replacement_configured_metadata"]
    counts.append(len(app["sources"]))
assert counts == [9, 9, 11, 14] and len(files) == 22
archive_pins = {
    "phase1-audit-log": "eef1631d2fdc7941ebc3b4faadf7f88b764659c850e129322a777ff30a6a2a9e",
    "phase1-risk-stub": "8dba6e77bd72e29e129adf7a3e772f9fd487647cd064664a71585a59d5723dbd",
    "phase1-memory": "c444a776be6a3851b1c4a4682d00da70c7a001dc08c9d5a61ddced79d90ff256",
    "phase1-orchestrator": "e12549f244e065d19ff95e418685a28b96e46450a99f1d99924168f0a3fa943e",
}
for app in m["applications"]:
    archive = (root / "docs/review_artifacts/companion_import_inventory_20261018/source_bundle" / (app["name"] + "-sources.tar")).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest() == archive_pins[app["name"]]
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive), mode="r:*") as t:
        members = t.getmembers()
        assert all(x.isfile() and x.name.endswith(".py") for x in members)
        by_name = {x.name: x for x in members}
        assert len(by_name) == len(members)
        for s in app["sources"]:
            assert hashlib.sha256(t.extractfile(by_name[s["local"]]).read()).hexdigest() == s["sha256"]
plan = install.Plan.load(raw["reviewed"], expected["reviewed"])
assert plan.staged and plan.running_storage
assert set(plan.deferred_startup_policies) == install.STARTUP_POLICIES
try:
    install.Plan.load(raw["candidate"], expected["candidate"])
except Exception:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("unapproved candidate accepted")
print(json.dumps({"state": "OFFLINE_PACKET_CHECKS_PASSED", "baseline_rows": 7, "source_entries": sum(counts), "unique_source_files": len(files), "predictions_recomputed": 4, "changed_fields": ["decision", "reviewer"], "reviewed_sha256": expected["reviewed"], "native_operations": False}, sort_keys=True))
PY
